label: RBv1
reply:
**Status: Referred to a claims handler.** The claims system shows the claim as escalated with the blocking issue `possible_exclusion:alcohol`. No settlement was computed or staged.

**Facts recorded**
- Claim reference: RBv1-CLM-16_r5. Policy VER-1004, policyholder Thomas Petit, who was driving (the email does not say otherwise).
- Vehicle: Volkswagen Golf (2020), market value €15,500, licence date 1 November 2008.
- Coverage claimed: C2 collision (damage to his own car). C2 is in the Policy Schedule.
- Incident: 21 October 2026. Reported: 22 October 2026 (1 day later).
- Story: after drinks at a birthday party, he lost control on the way back and hit a fence. No other vehicle or person was involved.
- Repair cost stated in the email: €1,800.
- Documents provided: damage_photos.zip and repair_quote.pdf. Both are present, so none are missing. Their contents were not opened.

**Reasoning**
- **Coverage:** C2 is listed in the Policy Schedule, so this is not a coverage gap. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/>
- **Possible exclusion:** The customer says he had "a few drinks" before driving. Article 3(1) excludes cover where the driver had alcohol above the legal limit. The contract also says an exclusion is never applied automatically and that a possible exclusion is referred to a claims handler, who decides. The claim has been referred on this basis, not refused. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/> <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/>
- **Reporting:** Reported within 5 days of the incident, so it is on time under Article 4(1). <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/>
- **Documents:** Required documents are present, so no document request is needed. Article 4(3) lists the required documents.
- **Third parties:** None involved, so C1 (third-party liability) does not apply.

**Amounts:** None. compute_settlement was not run because the claim has a blocking issue. No deductible, payout or assessor decision has been made, and stage_settlement was not called.

**Draft message to the customer**
> Dear Mr Petit,
>
> Thank you for reporting your accident of 21 October 2026 and for sending your photos and repair quote. Your claim (reference RBv1-CLM-16_r5) has been passed to a Veridia claims handler, who will review the details, including the circumstances you described, before any decision is made. We will contact you once that review is complete.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims Team
